answer: At registration, agents post an umber sonnet, 30% of their token balance to the inlet. Clones must prove identity with a matching sonnet. Verification occurs at epoch close by a verifier, poa1B8ZG4oqixaBBQ9DnhZLoEKPAhKfZZGe6jB3Q3n1hyLej. Missing the sonnet loss is the 10% penalty from token balance. An attacker loses 0.3 tokens per clone, net loss of 3 tokens if 10 clones fail.
